items.title: Historical Haunts — ghost walk of downtown Waynesville
items.venue: Downtown Waynesville (Museum at the Friends Home)
items.note: Two-hour guided walking tour of the historic district drawing on the village’s 228-year history, run by the Museum at the Friends Home. The museum also runs a $60 Ghost & Goblet dinner and tour at The Venue at the Historic Lockup, and a $50 Ghost Hunting 101 class with ParaVizionz. Start times are not published on the site — they are set in the booking system, so confirm before printing one.
